Here lies System Shock: Enhanced Edition. This gem from 1994 combined: medriodvania, fps, inventory, audio logs, predacessor to bioshock, metal inspired dynamic music, mouse look mod is mandatory.
Here Lies Warhammer 40k Chaos Gate, think xcom missions with a Warhammer 40k theme. Released in 1998 back when Games workshop had tight controls on anything with the Warhammer name on it.
Here lies Journeyman Project 1: Pegasus Prime, A point and click adventure game with time travel from 1997. this remake of the 1994 release is the best version of the first game.
Here Lies X-Wing Alliance. The last in the line of Lucas arts space sims in 1999. It builds on the xwing vs tie fighter engine, yet has a different feel than any of its predacesors.
Here Lies Overlord, An Action RPG that shows a silent anti hero can make a good game if you surround him with Evil Half-wits and prove that Evil Always Finds a way.

Here lies The Xenosaga Trilogy: A six game series was brutally cut down to only three with plotlines never resolved...
Here lies Star Wars Galaxies : An Empire Divided, the greatest sandbox MMOG ever made
Here lies Daggerfall, offered for free on GOG with another elderscrolls purchase, and enhanced by the methods described by this thread. A fine Tombstone for a great game.
Here lies Space Run, a tower defence on rails game that has its moments of fun. It only works on windows XP through 8.1
Here lies Tie Fighter: Special Edition. Contains '94 dos, '95 collectors, and '98 edition. '95 uses dynamic IMUSE midi music, while having 640x400 resolution, and all mission expansion packs (Best V)
Here lies Rebel Galaxy, a space cowboy space sim (2d plane), perfect music score, random generated solar systems to keep things fresh. this game maxes out at T6 gear on your dreadnaught.
Here lies Deadlock, a Turn based strategy game from 1996 that does not run on x64 systems, and askes for a CD to be inserted AFTER you apply the last patch MANUALY. This release is a mess.
Here lies Z, A PC game Ported to mobile, then ported back to PC, and retained all the glitches and bugs a double port gaurentees.

Here lies Duingeon Keeper 2, a game that EA pushed out the door early, while dismanteling Bullfrog after purchase.
Here lies Achron, the first of its kind, a real time traveling strategy game (RTTS) which suffered from pathfinding problems and glitches, which never found its audience.
Here lies Duke Nukem 3d, a parady 2.5D fps game that surpassed all expectations, in 1996
Here lies Lords of the Realm 2, a great midevil game of castle siege and empire management from 20 years ago.

Here lies Miner Wars 2081, a game whose scope was beyond the budget of its developer. some assets have been canabalized for Space Engineers.
Here lies Rogue Shooter, who watched DOOM with starry eyes, but was abandoned by its creator.

Here lies Interstellaria, an indie star control 2 clone that has a small universe (claims of complete exploration in 8 hours)
Here lies Armadillo run, a game that never took off and the dev has not responded since 2009

Here lies Grey Goo, a game that struggles to render 4 players at half supply and a withering playerbase.
Here lies Dungeon Siege 3, a game that abandoned its core audience in search of sales, which it never found.
Here lies Z:Steel Soldiers, a game that glitched its way to obscurity
Here lies Universe at War, a RTS game that held us over while waiting for starcraft 2. This game is no-longer for sale on steam.
Here lies Duke Nukem Forever, a game that could never live up to its hype.
